verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's left-to-right order (product circle, then headline, subline and CTA) with a clean left-aligned text column and clear hierarchy. Its flaws are small: the headline sits tight to the right edge, and the circle almost touches the top and bottom edges. B breaks the reading order by putting 'Out now.' after the button. Its oversized 'Try It' pill butts against the bottom of the product circle, and the right side is jammed into a cluster while the headline floats alone on the left with a dead gap between them.
